mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic stimulant) may antagonize the antihypertensive and CNS effects of guanfacine (alpha-2 agonist), while guanfacine may potentiate stimulant cardiovascular effects through additive sympathetic modulation.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and behavioral/psychiatric symptoms closely; dosage adjustments may be necessary, and this combination is sometimes used therapeutically but requires careful supervision.
